I wrote `component.html` in the folder: a 1280px sign-in screen inside `#component`, using only `DESIGN.md` and `tokens.css`. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and look are unchecked.

- **Content:** all seven items from the acceptance criteria use your exact wording. I added no other text.
- **Layout:** a 400px card centered on a white page, with the heading on top and the fields stacked below it. "Keep me signed in" and "Forgot Password?" share a row above the two full-width buttons.
- **Following `DESIGN.md`:** colours and sizes come from the light-theme tokens, which I inlined so the file is self-contained. Buttons, fields and the link follow the spec: 44px pills, ink primary, outlined secondary, accent-blue focus rings.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo can't load without an external stylesheet, so the page falls back to the system font.

The heading may wrap to two lines.
